   RESPUESTAS COGNOSCITIVAS
========================================================= */

const ANSWERS = {

    q1:"B",
    q2:"B",
    q3:"B",
    q4:"C",
    q5:"B",

    q6sensor:"C",
    q6actuator:"A",
    q6micro:"B",

    q7:"B",
    q8:"B",
    q9:"B",
    q10:"A"

};


const cognitiveNames = [

    "Microcontrolador",
    "Sensor y actuador",
    "Entrada–proceso–salida",
    "Algoritmo",
    "Estructura condicional",
    "Funciones de sensor, actuador y microcontrolador",
    "Dato",
    "Representación condicional",
    "Depuración",
    "Almacenamiento de datos"

];


const socioNames = [

    "Gusto por la precisión",
    "Aprender del error",
    "Flexibilidad para manejar problemas",
    "Tolerancia a la frustración",
    "Manejo de las tecnologías de forma ética y segura",
    "Pensamiento creativo"

];



/* =========================================================
   RENDERIZAR INFORME VISUAL — ALINEADO CON APP DOCENTE
========================================================= */

function escaparHTMLInforme(valor){

    return String(valor ?? "")
        .replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
        .replace(/</g,"&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g,"&#039;");

}


function nivelClaseInforme(codigo){

    if(codigo === "DC") return "level-DC";
    if(codigo === "EC") return "level-EC";
    if(codigo === "RC") return "level-RC";
    return "";

}


function badgeInforme(estado){

    const codigo = String(estado || "NA")
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    const nombres = {
        L:"Logrado",
        EP:"En proceso",
        RA:"Requiere apoyo",
        F:"Favorable",
        NA:"No valorado"
    };

    const clase = ["L","EP","RA","F","NA"].includes(codigo)
        ? codigo
        : "NA";

    return `
        <span class="badge badge-${clase}">
            ${escaparHTMLInforme(nombres[codigo] || codigo)}
        </span>
    `;

}


function tablaCognoscitivaInforme(resultados){

    const filas = resultados.map(
        (resultado,index)=>{

            return `
                <tr>
                    <td><strong>C${index+1}</strong></td>
                    <td>${escaparHTMLInforme(resultado.name)}</td>
                    <td>${escaparHTMLInforme(
                        `${resultado.correct}/${resultado.total}`
                    )}</td>
                </tr>
            `;

        }
    ).join("");

    return `
        <div class="table-container">
            <table>
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Código</th>
                        <th>Saber conceptual</th>
                        <th>Resultado</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>${filas}</tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    `;

}


function tablaProcedimentalInforme(procedural){

    const resultados = [
        ["P2","Reconoce patrones",procedural.recognizesPatterns],
        ["P3","Abstrae",procedural.abstrae],
        ["P4","Transfiere",procedural.transfiere],
        ["P5","Modulariza",procedural.modulariza]
    ];

    const filas = resultados.map(
        item=>`
            <tr>
                <td><strong>${item[0]}</strong></td>
                <td>${escaparHTMLInforme(item[1])}</td>
                <td>${badgeInforme(item[2])}</td>
            </tr>
        `
    ).join("");

    return `
        <div class="table-container">
            <table>
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Código</th>
                        <th>Saber procedimental</th>
                        <th>Resultado</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>${filas}</tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    `;

}


function tablaSocioafectivaInforme(resultados){

    const filas = resultados.map(
        (resultado,index)=>`
            <tr>
                <td><strong>S${index+1}</strong></td>
                <td>${escaparHTMLInforme(resultado.name)}</td>
                <td>${badgeInforme(socioCode(resultado.answer))}</td>
            </tr>
        `
    ).join("");

    return `
        <div class="table-container">
            <table>
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Código</th>
                        <th>Saber socioafectivo</th>
                        <th>Resultado</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>${filas}</tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    `;

}


function listaInforme(items,clase,emptyText){

    if(!items || !items.length){

        return `
            <div class="list-box ${clase}">
                ${escaparHTMLInforme(emptyText)}
            </div>
        `;

    }

    return `
        <div class="list-box ${clase}">
            <ul>
                ${items.map(
                    item=>`
                        <li>${escaparHTMLInforme(item)}</li>
                    `
                ).join("")}
            </ul>
        </div>
    `;

}


function renderStudentReport(data,qrData){

    const resultado = `${data.score}/10`;
    const nivel = data.level.code;
    const nivelTexto = data.level.label;

    return `

        <div class="student-header">

            <div class="student-meta">
                Centro educativo:
                <strong>
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(data.institution || "—")}
                </strong>
            </div>

            <div class="student-name">
                ${escaparHTMLInforme(data.student || "—")}
            </div>

            <div class="student-section">
                Sección:
                <strong>
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(data.section || "—")}
                </strong>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="report-summary-grid">

            <div class="report-summary-card">
                <div class="title">RESULTADO COGNOSCITIVO</div>
                <div class="value">${escaparHTMLInforme(resultado)}</div>
            </div>

            <div class="report-summary-card">
                <div class="title">NIVEL</div>
                <div class="value ${nivelClaseInforme(nivel)}">
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(nivel)}
                </div>
                <div class="sub">
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(nivelTexto)}
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>


        <h3>COGNOSCITIVA</h3>

        ${tablaCognoscitivaInforme(data.knowledgeResults)}


        <h3>EVIDENCIAS DE LA ACTIVIDAD PRÁCTICA</h3>

        <div class="notice info">
            Estas evidencias corresponden a la actividad práctica
            realizada durante el diagnóstico. Las conexiones se
            reportan únicamente cuando son técnicamente correctas.
        </div>

        <div class="report-summary-grid">

            <div class="report-summary-card">
                <div class="title">TARJETAS CORRECTAMENTE ORGANIZADAS</div>
                <div class="value">
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(data.procedural.cardsCorrect || "—")}
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="report-summary-card">
                <div class="title">CONEXIONES TÉCNICAMENTE CORRECTAS</div>
                <div class="value">
                    ${escaparHTMLInforme(data.procedural.correctConnections || "—")}
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>


        <h3>SABERES PROCEDIMENTALES</h3>

        ${tablaProcedimentalInforme(data.procedural)}


        <h3>SOCIOAFECTIVA</h3>

        ${tablaSocioafectivaInforme(data.socio)}


        <h3>FORTALEZAS</h3>

        ${listaInforme(
            data.strengths,
            "strength-box",
            "No se identificaron fortalezas en este diagnóstico."
        )}


        <h3>APOYO</h3>

        ${listaInforme(
            data.support,
            "support-box",
            "Sin prioridades conceptuales."
        )}


        <h3>INFORMACIÓN QR</h3>

        <div class="qr-original">
            ${escaparHTMLInforme(qrData || "")}
        </div>

    `;

}


/* =========================================================
   FECHA
========================================================= */

function setToday(){

    const input =
        document.getElementById("date");


    if(!input.value){

        const d = new Date();

        const y =
            d.getFullYear();

        const m =
            String(d.getMonth()+1)
            .padStart(2,"0");

        const day =
            String(d.getDate())
            .padStart(2,"0");

        input.value =
            `${y}-${m}-${day}`;

    }

}

setToday();


/* =========================================================
   NAVEGACIÓN
========================================================= */

function goToStage(stage){

    document.querySelectorAll(".stage")
        .forEach(
            element =>
                element.classList.remove("active")
        );


    document.getElementById(
        "stage"+stage
    ).classList.add("active");


    currentStage = stage;


    const percent =
        stage * 25;


    document.getElementById(
        "stageLabel"
    ).textContent =
        `Etapa ${stage} de 4`;


    document.getElementById(
        "progressPercent"
    ).textContent =
        percent+"%";


    document.getElementById(
        "progressBar"
    ).style.width =
        percent+"%";


    window.scrollTo({
        top:0,
        behavior:"smooth"
    });


    if(stage === 2){

        setTimeout(
            drawConnections,
            100
        );

    }

}


/* =========================================================
   TEMPORIZADOR
========================================================= */

function startTimer(){

    timerInterval =
        setInterval(
            ()=>{

                if(
                    remainingSeconds <= 0
                ){

                    clearInterval(
                        timerInterval
                    );

                    document.getElementById(
                        "timer"
                    ).textContent =
                        "00:00";

                    return;

                }


                remainingSeconds--;

                updateTimer();

            },
            1000
        );


    updateTimer();

}


function updateTimer(){

    const minutes =
        Math.floor(
            remainingSeconds/60
        );


    const seconds =
        remainingSeconds%60;


    document.getElementById(
        "timer"
    ).textContent =

        String(minutes)
        .padStart(2,"0")

        +

        ":"

        +

        String(seconds)
        .padStart(2,"0");

}


startTimer();


/* =========================================================
   RADIO
========================================================= */

function getRadio(name){

    const selected =
        document.querySelector(
            `input[name="${name}"]:checked`
        );


    return selected
        ? selected.value
        : null;

}


/* =========================================================
   ETAPA 1
========================================================= */

function identityComplete(){

    const nombre =
        document.getElementById(
            "studentName"
        ).value.trim();

    const section =
        document.getElementById(
            "section"
        ).value.trim();

    const institution =
        document.getElementById(
            "institution"
        ).value.trim();


    return (

        nombre !== ""

        &&

        section !== ""

        &&

        institution !== ""

    );

}


function updateStage1Button(){

    const button =
        document.getElementById(
            "btnStage1"
        );


    if(!button){
        return;
    }


    button.disabled =
        !identityComplete();

}


function cognitiveComplete(){

    const fields = [

        "q1",
        "q2",
        "q3",
        "q4",
        "q5",

        "q6sensor",
        "q6actuator",
        "q6micro",

        "q7",
        "q8",
        "q9",
        "q10"

    ];


    return fields.every(
        field =>
            getRadio(field) !== null
    );

}


function finishStage1(){

    const message =
        document.getElementById(
            "stage1Message"
        );


    if(!identityComplete()){

        message.textContent =
            "Complete el nombre, la sección y el centro educativo antes de continuar.";

        updateStage1Button();

        return;

    }


    if(!cognitiveComplete()){

        message.textContent =
            "Complete las 10 preguntas antes de continuar.";

        return;

    }


    message.textContent =
        "Datos y preguntas completos.";


    goToStage(2);

}


/* =========================================================
   RESULTADOS COGNOSCITIVOS
========================================================= */

function getCognitiveResults(){

    const results = [];


    const normal = [

        "q1",
        "q2",
        "q3",
        "q4",
        "q5"

    ];


    normal.forEach(
        name => {

            const answer =
                getRadio(name);


            results.push({

                answer:answer,

                correct:
                    answer ===
                    ANSWERS[name]

            });

        }
    );


    const q6s =
        getRadio("q6sensor");


    const q6a =
        getRadio("q6actuator");


    const q6m =
        getRadio("q6micro");


    results.push({

        answer:{

            sensor:q6s,

            actuator:q6a,

            micro:q6m

        },

        correct:

            q6s === ANSWERS.q6sensor

            &&

            q6a === ANSWERS.q6actuator

            &&

            q6m === ANSWERS.q6micro

    });


    [

        "q7",
        "q8",
        "q9",
        "q10"

    ].forEach(
        name => {

            const answer =
                getRadio(name);


            results.push({

                answer:answer,

                correct:
                    answer ===
                    ANSWERS[name]

            });

        }
    );


    return results;

}


function cognitiveScore(results){

    return results.filter(
        result =>
            result.correct
    ).length;

}


function cognitiveLevel(score){

    if(score >= 8){

        return {

            code:"DC",

            label:
                "Dominio conceptual consolidado"

        };

    }


    if(score >= 5){

        return {

            code:"EC",

            label:
                "En proceso de consolidación"

        };

    }


    return {

        code:"RC",

        label:
            "Requiere reforzamiento conceptual"

    };

}


/* =========================================================
   TARJETAS
========================================================= */

function dragStart(event){

    draggedCard =
        event.currentTarget;


    event.dataTransfer.setData(
        "text/plain",
        draggedCard.id
    );


    event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed =
        "move";

}


function allowDrop(event){

    event.preventDefault();


    if(
        event.currentTarget.classList
    ){

        event.currentTarget
            .classList.add(
                "drag-over"
            );

    }

}


document.addEventListener(
    "dragend",
    ()=>{

        document.querySelectorAll(
            ".drop-zone"
        ).forEach(
            zone =>
                zone.classList.remove(
                    "drag-over"
                )
        );

    }
);


function dropCard(event){

    event.preventDefault();


    const zone =
        event.currentTarget;


    zone.classList.remove(
        "drag-over"
    );


    const cardId =
        event.dataTransfer.getData(
            "text/plain"
        );


    const card =
        document.getElementById(
            cardId
        );


    if(!card){
        return;
    }


    const content =
        zone.querySelector(
            ".zone-content"
        );


    const existing =
        content.querySelector(
            ".component-card"
        );


    if(
        existing &&
        existing !== card
    ){

        document.getElementById(
            "cardsTray"
        ).appendChild(
            existing
        );

    }


    content.appendChild(card);


    updateCardsStatus();

}


function dropToTray(event){

    event.preventDefault();


    const cardId =
        event.dataTransfer.getData(
            "text/plain"
        );


    const card =
        document.getElementById(
            cardId
        );


    if(card){

        document.getElementById(
            "cardsTray"
        ).appendChild(
            card
        );

    }


    updateCardsStatus();

}


/*
   BOTÓN:
   REACOMODAR TARJETAS
*/

function resetCards(){

    const tray =
        document.getElementById(
            "cardsTray"
        );


    /*
       Orden inicial:
       Actuador → Sensor → Microcontrolador
    */

    tray.appendChild(
        document.getElementById(
            "card-actuator"
        )
    );


    tray.appendChild(
        document.getElementById(
            "card-sensor"
        )
    );


    tray.appendChild(
        document.getElementById(
            "card-micro"
        )
    );


    updateCardsStatus();

}


function getCardsPlaced(){

    return document.querySelectorAll(
        ".zone-content .component-card"
    ).length;

}


function getCardArrangement(){

    function cardId(zone){

        const card =
            document.querySelector(
                `#zone-${zone} .component-card`
            );


        return card
            ? card.dataset.id
            : null;

    }


    return {

        input:
            cardId("input"),

        process:
            cardId("process"),

        output:
            cardId("output")

    };

}


function updateCardsStatus(){

    const count =
        getCardsPlaced();


    const missing =
        3-count;


    const message =
        document.getElementById(
            "cardsStatus"
        );


    if(missing > 0){

        message.textContent =
            `Faltan ${missing} tarjetas por colocar.`;

    }else{

        message.textContent =
            "Las tres tarjetas están colocadas.";

    }


    updateStage2Button();

}


/* =========================================================
   CONEXIONES
========================================================= */


/*
   PUERTOS QUE DEBEN ESTAR CONECTADOS
   PARA PODER AVANZAR:

   SENSOR:
   - VCC
   - GND
   - SIG

   ACTUADOR:
   - VCC
   - SIG

   TOTAL = 5

   Los puertos del microcontrolador pueden participar
   en conexiones, pero no son necesarios individualmente
   para desbloquear la etapa.
*/

const requiredPorts = [

    "port-sensor-vcc",
    "port-sensor-gnd",
    "port-sensor-sig",

    "port-led-vcc",
    "port-led-sig"

];


/*
   CONEXIONES TÉCNICAMENTE ESPERADAS.

   Se almacenan internamente.
   NO se muestran al estudiante.
*/

const expectedConnections = [

    [
        "sensor",
        "VCC",
        "micro",
        "VCC"
    ],

    [
        "sensor",
        "GND",
        "micro",
        "GND"
    ],

    [
        "sensor",
        "SIG",
        "micro",
        "ANALÓGICO"
    ],

    [
        "micro",
        "VCC",
        "led",
        "VCC"
    ],

    [
        "micro",
        "DIGITAL",
        "led",
        "SIG"
    ]

];


function getPortInfo(id){

    const element =
        document.getElementById(id);


    if(!element){
        return null;
    }


    return {

        id:id,

        device:
            element.dataset.device,

        port:
            element.dataset.port

    };

}


function connectionCorrect(a,b){

    return expectedConnections.some(
        expected => {

            const direct =

                a.device === expected[0]

                &&

                a.port === expected[1]

                &&

                b.device === expected[2]

                &&

                b.port === expected[3];


            const reverse =

                a.device === expected[2]

                &&

                a.port === expected[3]

                &&

                b.device === expected[0]

                &&

                b.port === expected[1];


            return direct || reverse;

        }
    );

}


function connectionAlreadyExists(
    fromId,
    toId
){

    return connections.some(
        connection =>

            (

                connection.from === fromId

                &&

                connection.to === toId

            )

            ||

            (

                connection.from === toId

                &&

                connection.to === fromId

            )
    );

}


function selectPort(element){

    /*
       Primer puerto.
    */

    if(selectedPort === null){

        selectedPort =
            element.id;


        element.classList.add(
            "selected"
        );


        return;

    }


    /*
       Mismo puerto:
       cancelar selección.
    */

    if(
        selectedPort === element.id
    ){

        element.classList.remove(
            "selected"
        );


        selectedPort = null;


        return;

    }


    const first =
        document.getElementById(
            selectedPort
        );


    const second =
        element;


    if(!first){

        selectedPort = null;

        return;

    }


    /*
       No crear cables duplicados.
    */

    if(
        !connectionAlreadyExists(
            first.id,
            second.id
        )
    ){

        const infoA =
            getPortInfo(
                first.id
            );


        const infoB =
            getPortInfo(
                second.id
            );


        connections.push({

            id:
                createId(),

            from:
                first.id,

            to:
                second.id,

            fromDevice:
                infoA.device,

            fromPort:
                infoA.port,

            toDevice:
                infoB.device,

            toPort:
                infoB.port,


            /*
               INFORMACIÓN INTERNA.
               NO SE MUESTRA.
            */

            technicallyCorrect:
                connectionCorrect(
                    infoA,
                    infoB
                ),

            timestamp:
                new Date().toISOString()

        });

    }


    document.querySelectorAll(
        ".port"
    ).forEach(
        port =>
            port.classList.remove(
                "selected"
            )
    );


    selectedPort = null;


    updatePortStatus();

    drawConnections();

    updateConnectionMessage();

    updateStage2Button();

}


/*
   Visualmente solo se indica que el puerto
   ya participa en una conexión.
   No se indica si la conexión es correcta.
*/

function updatePortStatus(){

    document.querySelectorAll(
        ".port"
    ).forEach(
        port => {

            port.classList.remove(
                "connected"
            );


            const connected =
                connections.some(
                    connection =>

                        connection.from ===
                        port.id

                        ||

                        connection.to ===
                        port.id
                );


            if(connected){

                port.classList.add(
                    "connected"
                );

            }

        }
    );

}


/*
   Cuenta puertos obligatorios conectados.
*/

function connectedRequiredPorts(){

    return requiredPorts.filter(
        portId =>

            connections.some(
                connection =>

                    connection.from ===
                    portId

                    ||

                    connection.to ===
                    portId
            )
    ).length;

}


function missingRequiredPorts(){

    return (

        requiredPorts.length
        -
        connectedRequiredPorts()

    );

}


/*
   ÚNICA devolución sobre conexiones.
*/

function updateConnectionMessage(){

    const missing =
        missingRequiredPorts();


    document.getElementById(
        "connectionStatus"
    ).textContent =

        `Faltan ${missing} puertos por conectar`;

}


/*
   REINICIAR CONEXIONES
*/

function resetConnections(){

    connections = [];

    selectedPort = null;


    document.querySelectorAll(
        ".port"
    ).forEach(
        port => {

            port.classList.remove(
                "selected"
            );

            port.classList.remove(
                "connected"
            );

        }
    );


    document.getElementById(
        "connectionSvg"
    ).innerHTML = "";


    updateConnectionMessage();

    updateStage2Button();

}


/* =========================================================
   COLOR DE CABLE
========================================================= */

function getCableColor(a,b){

    const ports = [
        a.port,
        b.port
    ];


    if(
        ports.includes("GND")
    ){

        return "#111827";

    }


    if(
        ports.includes("VCC")
    ){

        return "#dc2626";

    }


    if(
        ports.includes("ANALÓGICO")
    ){

        return "#f97316";

    }


    if(
        ports.includes("DIGITAL")
    ){

        return "#16a34a";

    }


    return "#64748b";

}


/* =========================================================
   DIBUJAR CONEXIONES
========================================================= */

function drawConnections(){

    const svg =
        document.getElementById(
            "connectionSvg"
        );


    if(!svg){
        return;
    }


    svg.innerHTML = "";


    /*
       En pantalla pequeña se mantienen
       las conexiones almacenadas, pero no
       se dibujan sobre dispositivos apilados.
    */

    if(
        window.innerWidth <= 850
    ){

        return;

    }


    const wrapper =
        document.getElementById(
            "circuitWrapper"
        );


    const wrapperRect =
        wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();


    connections.forEach(
        connection => {

            const a =
                document.getElementById(
                    connection.from
                );


            const b =
                document.getElementById(
                    connection.to
                );


            if(!a || !b){
                return;
            }


            const ra =
                a.getBoundingClientRect();


            const rb =
                b.getBoundingClientRect();


            const x1 =
                ra.left -
                wrapperRect.left +
                ra.width/2;


            const y1 =
                ra.top -
                wrapperRect.top +
                ra.height/2;


            const x2 =
                rb.left -
                wrapperRect.left +
                rb.width/2;


            const y2 =
                rb.top -
                wrapperRect.top +
                rb.height/2;


            const infoA =
                getPortInfo(
                    connection.from
                );


            const infoB =
                getPortInfo(
                    connection.to
                );


            const color =
                getCableColor(
                    infoA,
                    infoB
                );


            const path =
                document.createElementNS(
                    "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
                    "path"
                );


            const curve =
                Math.max(
                    60,
                    Math.abs(x2-x1)*.45
                );


            const c1x =
                x2 >= x1
                    ? x1+curve
                    : x1-curve;


            const c2x =
                x2 >= x1
                    ? x2-curve
                    : x2+curve;


            path.setAttribute(
                "d",
                `
                M ${x1} ${y1}
                C ${c1x} ${y1},
                  ${c2x} ${y2},
                  ${x2} ${y2}
                `
            );


            path.setAttribute(
                "fill",
                "none"
            );


            path.setAttribute(
                "stroke",
                color
            );


            path.setAttribute(
                "stroke-width",
                "5"
            );


            path.setAttribute(
                "stroke-linecap",
                "round"
            );


            svg.appendChild(path);

        }
    );

}


window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    drawConnections
);


/* =========================================================
   ETAPA 2
========================================================= */

function updateStage2Button(){

    const cards =
        getCardsPlaced();


    const missingPorts =
        missingRequiredPorts();


    const complete =
        cards === 3
        &&
        missingPorts === 0;


    document.getElementById(
        "btnStage2"
    ).disabled =
        !complete;


    const message =
        document.getElementById(
            "stage2Message"
        );


    const missingCards =
        3-cards;

    const correctCards =
        tarjetasCorrectamenteColocadasCount();


    if(
        missingCards > 0 &&
        missingPorts > 0
    ){

        message.textContent =
            `Tarjetas correctamente organizadas: ${correctCards}/3. Faltan ${missingCards} tarjetas por colocar y ${missingPorts} puertos por conectar.`;

        return;

    }


    if(
        missingCards > 0
    ){

        message.textContent =
            `Tarjetas correctamente organizadas: ${correctCards}/3. Faltan ${missingCards} tarjetas por colocar.`;

        return;

    }


    if(
        missingPorts > 0
    ){

        message.textContent =
            `Tarjetas correctamente organizadas: ${correctCards}/3. Faltan ${missingPorts} puertos por conectar.`;

        return;

    }


    message.textContent =
        `Tarjetas correctamente organizadas: ${correctCards}/3. Las dos actividades están completas.`;

}


function finishStage2(){

    const cards =
        getCardsPlaced();


    const missingPorts =
        missingRequiredPorts();


    if(cards < 3){

        const correctCards =
            tarjetasCorrectamenteColocadasCount();

        document.getElementById(
            "stage2Message"
        ).textContent =
            `Tarjetas correctamente organizadas: ${correctCards}/3. Faltan ${3-cards} tarjetas por colocar.`;

        return;

    }


    if(missingPorts > 0){

        document.getElementById(
            "stage2Message"
        ).textContent =
            `Faltan ${missingPorts} puertos por conectar.`;

        return;

    }


    goToStage(3);

}


/* =========================================================
   SOCIOAFECTIVA
========================================================= */

function socioComplete(){

    for(
        let i=1;
        i<=6;
        i++
    ){

        if(
            getRadio("a"+i) === null
        ){

            return false;

        }

    }


    return true;

}


function getSocioResults(){

    const results = [];


    /* CORRECCION 1: solo se vinculan al informe y al QR los cuatro saberes socioafectivos: gusto por la precision, aprender del error, flexibilidad para manejar problemas y tolerancia a la frustracion. Las preguntas 5 y 6 permanecen sin cambios en la actividad, pero no se reportan ni codifican. */
    for(
        let i=1;
        i<=4;
        i++
    ){

        results.push({

            name:
                socioNames[i-1],

            answer:
                getRadio("a"+i)

        });

    }


    return results;

}


/* =========================================================
   PROCEDIMENTAL
========================================================= */

function tarjetasCorrectamenteColocadasCount(){

    const arrangement =
        getCardArrangement();

    let correct = 0;


    if(
        arrangement.input === "sensor"
    ){
        correct++;
    }


    if(
        arrangement.process === "micro"
    ){
        correct++;
    }


    if(
        arrangement.output === "actuator"
    ){
        correct++;
    }


    return correct;

}


function tarjetasCorrectamenteOrganizadas(){

    return
        tarjetasCorrectamenteColocadasCount() === 3;

}


function contarConexionesCorrectas(){

    const indices = new Set();


    connections.forEach(
        connection => {

            const infoA = {
                device: connection.fromDevice,
                port: connection.fromPort
            };

            const infoB = {
                device: connection.toDevice,
                port: connection.toPort
            };


            const indice =
                expectedConnections.findIndex(
                    expected => {

                        const direct =
                            infoA.device === expected[0] &&
                            infoA.port === expected[1] &&
                            infoB.device === expected[2] &&
                            infoB.port === expected[3];


                        const reverse =
                            infoA.device === expected[2] &&
                            infoA.port === expected[3] &&
                            infoB.device === expected[0] &&
                            infoB.port === expected[1];


                        return direct || reverse;

                    }
                );


            if(indice >= 0){
                indices.add(indice);
            }

        }
    );


    return indices.size;

}


function getProceduralResults(){

    const cards =
        getCardsPlaced();


    const correctCards =
        tarjetasCorrectamenteColocadasCount();


    const correctConnections =
        contarConexionesCorrectas();


    const cardsCorrect =
        correctCards === 3;


    return {

        cardsCorrect:
            `${correctCards}/3`,

        recognizesPatterns:
            cardsCorrect
                ? "L"
                : "RA",

        abstrae:
            cardsCorrect
                ? "L"
                : "RA",

        transfiere:
            correctConnections === expectedConnections.length
                ? "L"
                : "RA",

        modulariza:
            cards === 3
                ? "L"
                : "RA",

        correctConnections:
            `${correctConnections}/${expectedConnections.length}`

    };

}



/* =========================================================
   FORTALEZAS
========================================================= */

function getStrengths(
    cognitiveResults,
    procedural
){

    const strengths = [];


    cognitiveResults.forEach(
        (result,index)=>{

            if(
                result.correct
            ){

                strengths.push(
                    "Dominio conceptual en " +
                    cognitiveNames[index]
                        .toLowerCase()
                );

            }

        }
    );


    if(
        procedural.modulariza === "L"
    ){

        strengths.push(
            "Evidencia procedimental en modulariza"
        );

    }


    return strengths;

}


/* =========================================================
   APOYO
========================================================= */

function getSupport(
    cognitiveResults
){

    const support = [];


    cognitiveResults.forEach(
        (result,index)=>{

            if(
                !result.correct
            ){

                support.push(
                    "Reforzar " +
                    cognitiveNames[index]
                        .toLowerCase()
                );

            }

        }
    );


    return support;

}


/* =========================================================
   CÓDIGOS SOCIOAFECTIVOS
========================================================= */

function socioCode(value){

    if(value === "L"){
        return "F";
    }

    if(value === "P"){
        return "EP";
    }

    if(value === "A"){
        return "RA";
    }

    return "NA";

}


/* =========================================================
   INFORME
========================================================= */

function getKnowledgeResults(){

    const q1 =
        getRadio("q1") === ANSWERS.q1;

    const q2 =
        getRadio("q2") === ANSWERS.q2;

    const q3 =
        getRadio("q3") === ANSWERS.q3;

    const q4 =
        getRadio("q4") === ANSWERS.q4;

    const q6sensor =
        getRadio("q6sensor") === ANSWERS.q6sensor;

    const q6actuator =
        getRadio("q6actuator") === ANSWERS.q6actuator;

    const q6micro =
        getRadio("q6micro") === ANSWERS.q6micro;

    const q7 =
        getRadio("q7") === ANSWERS.q7;

    const q8 =
        getRadio("q8") === ANSWERS.q8;

    const q10 =
        getRadio("q10") === ANSWERS.q10;


    const count = values =>
        values.filter(Boolean).length;


    return [

        {
            code:"AL",
            name:"Algoritmo",
            correct:count([q4,q8]),
            total:2
        },

        {
            code:"MC",
            name:"Microcontrolador",
            correct:count([q1,q3,q6micro]),
            total:3
        },

        {
            code:"SE",
            name:"Sensor",
            correct:count([q2,q3,q6sensor,q7]),
            total:4
        },

        {
            code:"AC",
            name:"Actuador",
            correct:count([q2,q3,q6actuator]),
            total:3
        },

        {
            code:"DA",
            name:"Dato",
            correct:count([q7]),
            total:1
        },

        {
            code:"AD",
            name:"Almacenamiento de datos",
            correct:count([q10]),
            total:1
        }

    ];

}


/* =========================================================
   INFORME
========================================================= */

function buildReport(){

    const student =
        document.getElementById(
            "studentName"
        ).value.trim();


    const section =
        document.getElementById(
            "section"
        ).value.trim();


    const institution =
        document.getElementById(
            "institution"
        ).value.trim();


    const date =
        document.getElementById(
            "date"
        ).value;


    const cognitiveResults =
        getCognitiveResults();


    const score =
        cognitiveScore(
            cognitiveResults
        );


    const level =
        cognitiveLevel(score);


    /* Misma matriz conceptual que se informa en K: del QR. */
    const knowledgeResults =
        getKnowledgeResults();


    const procedural =
        getProceduralResults();


    const socio =
        getSocioResults();


    const strengths =
        getStrengths(
            cognitiveResults,
            procedural
        );


    const support =
        getSupport(
            cognitiveResults
        );


    let report = "";


    report +=
        "DIAGNOSTICO FT 9NO\n";


    report +=
        "ESTUDIANTE: " +
        student +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "SECCION: " +
        section +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "CENTRO: " +
        institution +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "FECHA: " +
        formatDate(date) +
        "\n\n";


    report +=
        "COGNOSCITIVA\n";


    report +=
        "RESULTADO: " +
        score +
        "/10\n";


    report +=
        "NIVEL: " +
        level.label +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "DESGLOSE POR SABER (no acumulable):\n";


    knowledgeResults.forEach(
        result=>{

            report +=
                result.name +
                ": " +
                result.correct +
                "/" +
                result.total +
                "\n";

        }
    );


    report +=
        "\nPSICOMOTORA\n";


    report +=
        "TARJETAS CORRECTAMENTE ORGANIZADAS: " +
        procedural.cardsCorrect +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "SABERES PROCEDIMENTALES VALORADOS\n";


    report +=
        "Reconoce patrones: " +
        procedural.recognizesPatterns +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "Abstrae: " +
        procedural.abstrae +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "Transfiere: " +
        procedural.transfiere +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "Modulariza: " +
        procedural.modulariza +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "CONEXIONES TÉCNICAMENTE CORRECTAS: " +
        procedural.correctConnections +
        "\n";


    report +=
        "\nSOCIOAFECTIVA\n";


    socio.forEach(
        result=>{

            report +=
                result.name +
                ": " +
                socioCode(
                    result.answer
                ) +
                "\n";

        }
    );


    report +=
        "\nFORTALEZAS\n";


    if(
        strengths.length > 0
    ){

        strengths.forEach(
            item=>{

                report +=
                    "- " +
                    item +
                    "\n";

            }
        );

    }else{

        report +=
            "- En identificación\n";

    }


    report +=
        "\nAPOYO\n";


    if(
        support.length > 0
    ){

        support.forEach(
            item=>{

                report +=
                    "- " +
                    item +
                    "\n";

            }
        );

    }else{

        report +=
            "- Sin prioridades conceptuales\n";

    }


    return {

        report,

        student,

        section,

        institution,

        date,

        cognitiveResults,

        score,

        level,

        knowledgeResults,

        procedural,

        socio,

        strengths,

        support

    };

}


/* =========================================================
   FECHA
========================================================= */

function formatDate(value){

    if(!value){
        return "";
    }


    const parts =
        value.split("-");


    if(
        parts.length !== 3
    ){

        return value;

    }


    return (

        parts[2]
        +
        "/"
        +
        parts[1]
        +
        "/"
        +
        parts[0]

    );

}


/* =========================================================
   DATOS PARA QR
========================================================= */

/*
   El QR contiene solamente información compacta.

   No se incluyen:
   - textos largos
   - preguntas
   - respuestas completas
   - conexiones completas

   La información técnica completa de conexiones
   queda en localStorage.
*/

function qrSafe(text){

    return String(text)
        .replace(
            /[;\n\r|]/g,
            " "
        )
        .trim();

}


function qrShort(
    text,
    max
){

    text =
        qrSafe(text);


    if(
        text.length <= max
    ){

        return text;

    }


    return text.substring(
        0,
        max
    );

}


function buildQRData(data){

    /*
       FORMATO QR DOCENTE — D2

       El QR contiene una representación compacta de la MISMA
       información diagnóstica que se muestra en pantalla.

       Estructura compacta:

       D2|EST|SEC|CENTRO|FEC|C:6 saberes|P:tarjetas + 4 saberes procedimentales|S:4 socioafectivos|F:fortalezas|A:apoyos|R:resultado global|N:nivel|B:conexiones técnicamente correctas

       C = resultados agrupados por los seis saberes conceptuales
           que se muestran en el informe.
           Orden fijo:
           1 Algoritmo              (q4,q8)
           2 Microcontrolador       (q1,q3,q6micro)
           3 Sensor                 (q2,q3,q6sensor,q7)
           4 Actuador               (q2,q3,q6actuator)
           5 Dato                   (q7)
           6 Almacenamiento datos   (q10)

           Estos seis resultados son un desglose pedagógico y NO
           se suman para reconstruir el resultado global X/10.

           El resultado global X/10 se calcula a partir de las 10
           preguntas y se incorpora explícitamente al QR mediante R:.

       P = evidencia de actividad práctica + los cuatro saberes
           procedimentales valorados directamente:
           P1 Tarjetas correctamente organizadas / 3
           P2 Reconoce patrones
           P3 Abstrae
           P4 Transfiere
           P5 Modulariza

       B = cantidad de conexiones técnicamente correctas respecto
           de las 5 conexiones técnicamente esperadas.

       S = los cuatro resultados socioafectivos vinculados.
           F  = logrado
           EP = en proceso
           RA = requiere apoyo

       F = códigos de las fortalezas que aparecen en el informe.
           MC, SE, EPS, AL, EC, FSA, DA, RC, DE, AD = saberes
           MOD = evidencia procedimental en modulariza

       A = códigos de los apoyos que aparecen en el informe.
           MC, SE, EPS, AL, EC, FSA, DA, RC, DE, AD = saberes

       La APP DOCENTE utiliza estos códigos para reconstruir el
       mismo informe pedagógico, sin almacenar textos largos en QR.

       IMPORTANTE:
       El contenido del QR se genera exclusivamente con los datos
       que también alimentan el informe visible. No se cambian
       preguntas, navegación, colores ni estructura del diagnóstico.
    */

    const statusCode = result =>
        result && result.correct
            ? "L"
            : "RA";


    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       RESULTADOS POR LOS 6 SABERES CONCEPTUALES
       Se utiliza exactamente la misma función que la pantalla.

       El resultado global X/10 NO se duplica dentro del QR; se
       conserva como cálculo interno de la pantalla.
       --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const knowledgeResults =
        getKnowledgeResults()
            .map(
                result =>
                    `${result.correct}/${result.total}`
            )
            .join(",");


    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       PSICOMOTORA
       --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const procedural = [

        data.procedural.cardsCorrect,
        data.procedural.recognizesPatterns,
        data.procedural.abstrae,
        data.procedural.transfiere,
        data.procedural.modulariza

    ].join(",");


    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       SOCIOAFECTIVA
       --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const socio =
        data.socio
            .map(
                result =>
                    socioCode(result.answer)
            )
            .join(",");


    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FORTALEZAS Y APOYOS COMO CÓDIGOS
       --------------------------------------------------------- */

    const knowledgeCodes = [
        "MC",   /* Microcontrolador */
        "SE",   /* Sensor */
        "EPS",  /* Entrada-proceso-salida */
        "AL",   /* Algoritmo */
        "EC",   /* Estructura condicional */
        "FSA",  /* Funciones sensor/actuador/microcontrolador */
        "DA",   /* Dato */
        "RC",   /* Representación condicional */
        "DE",   /* Depuración */
        "AD"    /* Almacenamiento de datos */
    ];


    const strengthCodes = [];

    data.cognitiveResults.forEach(
        (result,index)=>{

            if(result.correct){

                strengthCodes.push(
                    knowledgeCodes[index]
                );

            }

        }
    );


    if(
        data.procedural.modulariza === "L"
    ){

        strengthCodes.push("MOD");

    }


    const supportCodes = [];

    data.cognitiveResults.forEach(
        (result,index)=>{

            if(!result.correct){

                supportCodes.push(
                    knowledgeCodes[index]
                );

            }

        }
    );


    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       FORMATO FINAL
       --------------------------------------------------------- */

    return (

        "D2"

        + "|" +
        qrShort(data.student,35)

        + "|" +
        qrShort(data.section,12)

        + "|" +
        qrShort(data.institution,30)

        + "|" +
        data.date

        + "|C:" +
        knowledgeResults

        + "|P:" +
        procedural

        + "|S:" +
        socio

        + "|F:" +
        strengthCodes.join(",")

        + "|A:" +
        supportCodes.join(",")

        + "|R:" +
        data.score +
        "/10"

        + "|N:" +
        data.level.code

        + "|B:" +
        data.procedural.correctConnections

    );

}

/* =========================================================
   QR OFFLINE
   Implementación autocontenida.
========================================================= */


/*
 * QR Code Generator
 * Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
 * Licencia MIT.
 *
 * Esta versión utiliza solamente las partes necesarias
 * para generar QR en el diagnóstico y está integrada
 * dentro de este HTML.
 *
 * No carga ningún recurso externo.
 */


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   GF(256)
--------------------------------------------------------- */

const QR_EXP = new Array(256);

const QR_LOG = new Array(256);


for(
    let i=0;
    i<8;
    i++
){

    QR_EXP[i] =
        1 << i;

}


for(
    let i=8;
    i<256;
    i++
){

    QR_EXP[i] =
        QR_EXP[i-4]
        ^
        QR_EXP[i-5]
        ^
        QR_EXP[i-6]
        ^
        QR_EXP[i-8];

}


for(
    let i=0;
    i<255;
    i++
){

    QR_LOG[
        QR_EXP[i]
    ] = i;

}


function qrGlog(n){

    if(n < 1){

        throw new Error(
            "glog"
        );

    }


    return QR_LOG[n];

}


function qrGexp(n){

    while(n < 0){

        n += 255;

    }


    while(n >= 256){

        n -= 255;

    }


    return QR_EXP[n];

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   POLINOMIOS
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function qrPolynomial(
    num,
    shift
){

    let offset = 0;


    while(
        offset < num.length &&
        num[offset] === 0
    ){

        offset++;

    }


    const values =
        new Array(
            num.length -
            offset +
            shift
        );


    for(
        let i=0;
        i<num.length-offset;
        i++
    ){

        values[i] =
            num[i+offset];

    }


    this.getAt =
        index =>
            values[index];


    this.getLength =
        () =>
            values.length;


    this.multiply =
        other => {

            const result =
                new Array(
                    this.getLength() +
                    other.getLength() -
                    1
                ).fill(0);


            for(
                let i=0;
                i<this.getLength();
                i++
            ){

                for(
                    let j=0;
                    j<other.getLength();
                    j++
                ){

                    result[i+j] ^=

                        qrGexp(

                            qrGlog(
                                this.getAt(i)
                            )

                            +

                            qrGlog(
                                other.getAt(j)
                            )

                        );

                }

            }


            return new qrPolynomial(
                result,
                0
            );

        };


    this.mod =
        other => {

            if(
                this.getLength() -
                other.getLength() < 0
            ){

                return this;

            }


            const ratio =

                qrGlog(
                    this.getAt(0)
                )

                -

                qrGlog(
                    other.getAt(0)
                );


            const result =
                this.getLength()
                    ? Array.from(
                        {
                            length:
                                this.getLength()
                        },
                        (_,i)=>
                            this.getAt(i)
                    )
                    : [];


            for(
                let i=0;
                i<other.getLength();
                i++
            ){

                result[i] ^=

                    qrGexp(

                        qrGlog(
                            other.getAt(i)
                        )

                        +

                        ratio

                    );

            }


            return new qrPolynomial(
                result,
                0
            ).mod(
                other
            );

        };

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   BITS
--------------------------------------------------------- */

class QRBitBuffer{

    constructor(){

        this.buffer = [];

        this.length = 0;

    }


    put(
        num,
        length
    ){

        for(
            let i=0;
            i<length;
            i++
        ){

            this.putBit(

                (
                    (
                        num >>>
                        (
                            length-i-1
                        )
                    )
                    &
                    1
                ) === 1

            );

        }

    }


    putBit(bit){

        const index =
            Math.floor(
                this.length/8
            );


        if(
            this.buffer.length <=
            index
        ){

            this.buffer.push(0);

        }


        if(bit){

            this.buffer[index] |=

                0x80 >>>
                (
                    this.length % 8
                );

        }


        this.length++;

    }

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   RS BLOCKS — QR VERSION 10, NIVEL L
--------------------------------------------------------- */

/*
   Versión 10-L:

   2 bloques de:
   86 total / 68 datos

   2 bloques de:
   87 total / 69 datos

   Total:
   274 bytes de datos.
*/

const QR_V10_L_BLOCKS = [

    {
        total:86,
        data:68
    },

    {
        total:86,
        data:68
    },

    {
        total:87,
        data:69
    },

    {
        total:87,
        data:69
    }

];


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   UTF-8
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function utf8Bytes(text){

    const bytes = [];


    for(
        const character of text
    ){

        const code =
            character.codePointAt(0);


        if(
            code <= 0x7f
        ){

            bytes.push(code);

        }
        else if(
            code <= 0x7ff
        ){

            bytes.push(

                0xc0 |
                (code >> 6),

                0x80 |
                (code & 0x3f)

            );

        }
        else if(
            code <= 0xffff
        ){

            bytes.push(

                0xe0 |
                (code >> 12),

                0x80 |
                ((code >> 6) & 0x3f),

                0x80 |
                (code & 0x3f)

            );

        }
        else{

            bytes.push(

                0xf0 |
                (code >> 18),

                0x80 |
                ((code >> 12) & 0x3f),

                0x80 |
                ((code >> 6) & 0x3f),

                0x80 |
                (code & 0x3f)

            );

        }

    }


    return bytes;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   GENERADOR RS
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function qrErrorPolynomial(
    length
){

    let polynomial =
        new qrPolynomial(
            [1],
            0
        );


    for(
        let i=0;
        i<length;
        i++
    ){

        polynomial =
            polynomial.multiply(

                new qrPolynomial(
                    [
                        1,
                        qrGexp(i)
                    ],
                    0
                )

            );

    }


    return polynomial;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   ECC
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function qrCreateBytes(
    dataBytes
){

    const blocks = [];

    let offset = 0;


    QR_V10_L_BLOCKS.forEach(
        blockInfo => {

            const data =
                dataBytes.slice(
                    offset,
                    offset +
                    blockInfo.data
                );


            offset +=
                blockInfo.data;


            const ecCount =
                blockInfo.total -
                blockInfo.data;


            const rsPolynomial =
                qrErrorPolynomial(
                    ecCount
                );


            const rawPolynomial =
                new qrPolynomial(
                    data,
                    rsPolynomial.getLength()-1
                );


            const modPolynomial =
                rawPolynomial.mod(
                    rsPolynomial
                );


            const ec =
                new Array(
                    rsPolynomial.getLength()-1
                );


            for(
                let i=0;
                i<ec.length;
                i++
            ){

                const modIndex =
                    i +
                    modPolynomial.getLength() -
                    ec.length;


                ec[i] =

                    modIndex >= 0

                    ?

                    modPolynomial.getAt(
                        modIndex
                    )

                    :

                    0;

            }


            blocks.push({

                data:data,

                ec:ec

            });

        }
    );


    const result = [];


    const maxData =
        Math.max(
            ...blocks.map(
                block =>
                    block.data.length
            )
        );


    const maxEC =
        Math.max(
            ...blocks.map(
                block =>
                    block.ec.length
            )
        );


    /*
       Intercalado de datos.
    */

    for(
        let i=0;
        i<maxData;
        i++
    ){

        blocks.forEach(
            block => {

                if(
                    i < block.data.length
                ){

                    result.push(
                        block.data[i]
                    );

                }

            }
        );

    }


    /*
       Intercalado de corrección.
    */

    for(
        let i=0;
        i<maxEC;
        i++
    ){

        blocks.forEach(
            block => {

                if(
                    i < block.ec.length
                ){

                    result.push(
                        block.ec[i]
                    );

                }

            }
        );

    }


    return result;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   BCH
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function qrBchDigit(data){

    let digit = 0;


    while(data !== 0){

        digit++;

        data >>>= 1;

    }


    return digit;

}


function qrBchTypeInfo(data){

    const G15 =
        (
            1 << 10
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 8
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 5
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 4
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 2
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 1
        )
        |
        1;


    const G15_MASK =
        (
            1 << 14
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 12
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 10
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 4
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 1
        );


    let d =
        data << 10;


    while(
        qrBchDigit(d) -
        qrBchDigit(G15) >=
        0
    ){

        d ^=

            G15 <<

            (
                qrBchDigit(d) -
                qrBchDigit(G15)
            );

    }


    return (

        (
            data << 10
        )
        |
        d

    )
    ^
    G15_MASK;

}


function qrBchTypeNumber(
    data
){

    const G18 =
        (
            1 << 12
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 11
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 10
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 9
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 8
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 5
        )
        |
        (
            1 << 2
        )
        |
        1;


    let d =
        data << 12;


    while(
        qrBchDigit(d) -
        qrBchDigit(G18) >=
        0
    ){

        d ^=

            G18 <<

            (
                qrBchDigit(d) -
                qrBchDigit(G18)
            );

    }


    return (

        data << 12

    )
    |
    d;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   MATRIZ QR
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function createQRMatrix(
    text
){

    const bytes =
        utf8Bytes(text);


    /*
       QR V10-L permite 271 bytes útiles
       en modo byte.
    */

    if(
        bytes.length > 271
    ){

        throw new Error(
            "El resumen QR supera la capacidad."
        );

    }


    const buffer =
        new QRBitBuffer();


    /*
       Modo BYTE.
    */

    buffer.put(
        4,
        4
    );


    /*
       Longitud: versión 10 usa 16 bits.
    */

    buffer.put(
        bytes.length,
        16
    );


    bytes.forEach(
        byte =>
            buffer.put(
                byte,
                8
            )
    );


    const totalDataBits =
        274 * 8;


    /*
       Terminador.
    */

    if(
        buffer.length + 4 <=
        totalDataBits
    ){

        buffer.put(
            0,
            4
        );

    }


    /*
       Completar byte.
    */

    while(
        buffer.length % 8 !== 0
    ){

        buffer.putBit(false);

    }


    /*
       Relleno.
    */

    let toggle = true;


    while(
        buffer.length <
        totalDataBits
    ){

        buffer.put(
            toggle
                ? 0xEC
                : 0x11,
            8
        );


        toggle =
            !toggle;

    }


    const dataBytes =
        buffer.buffer;


    const finalBytes =
        qrCreateBytes(
            dataBytes
        );


    const size = 57;


    const modules =
        Array.from(
            {length:size},
            () =>
                Array(size)
                    .fill(null)
        );


    function setModule(
        row,
        col,
        value
    ){

        if(
            row >= 0 &&
            row < size &&
            col >= 0 &&
            col < size
        ){

            modules[row][col] =
                !!value;

        }

    }


    /*
       Finder patterns.
    */

    function setupFinder(
        row,
        col
    ){

        for(
            let r=-1;
            r<=7;
            r++
        ){

            if(
                row+r < 0 ||
                row+r >= size
            ){

                continue;

            }


            for(
                let c=-1;
                c<=7;
                c++
            ){

                if(
                    col+c < 0 ||
                    col+c >= size
                ){

                    continue;

                }


                if(

                    (
                        r>=0 &&
                        r<=6 &&
                        (
                            c===0 ||
                            c===6
                        )
                    )

                    ||

                    (
                        c>=0 &&
                        c<=6 &&
                        (
                            r===0 ||
                            r===6
                        )
                    )

                    ||

                    (
                        r>=2 &&
                        r<=4 &&
                        c>=2 &&
                        c<=4
                    )

                ){

                    modules[row+r][col+c] =
                        true;

                }
                else{

                    modules[row+r][col+c] =
                        false;

                }

            }

        }

    }


    setupFinder(0,0);

    setupFinder(
        size-7,
        0
    );

    setupFinder(
        0,
        size-7
    );


    /*
       Timing.
    */

    for(
        let r=8;
        r<size-8;
        r++
    ){

        if(
            modules[r][6] === null
        ){

            modules[r][6] =
                r%2 === 0;

        }

    }


    for(
        let c=8;
        c<size-8;
        c++
    ){

        if(
            modules[6][c] === null
        ){

            modules[6][c] =
                c%2 === 0;

        }

    }


    /*
       Alignment patterns — V10:
       [6, 28, 50]
    */

    const positions =
        [6,28,50];


    positions.forEach(
        row => {

            positions.forEach(
                col => {

                    if(

                        (
                            row===6 &&
                            col===6
                        )

                        ||

                        (
                            row===6 &&
                            col===50
                        )

                        ||

                        (
                            row===50 &&
                            col===6
                        )

                    ){

                        return;

                    }


                    for(
                        let r=-2;
                        r<=2;
                        r++
                    ){

                        for(
                            let c=-2;
                            c<=2;
                            c++
                        ){

                            const dark =

                                r===-2 ||
                                r===2 ||
                                c===-2 ||
                                c===2 ||
                                (
                                    r===0 &&
                                    c===0
                                );


                            modules[
                                row+r
                            ][
                                col+c
                            ] =
                                dark;

                        }

                    }

                }
            );

        }
    );


    /*
       Información de versión.
    */

    const versionBits =
        qrBchTypeNumber(10);


    for(
        let i=0;
        i<18;
        i++
    ){

        const bit =
            (
                (
                    versionBits >>>
                    i
                )
                &
                1
            )
            === 1;


        modules[
            Math.floor(i/3)
        ][
            i%3 +
            size -
            8 -
            3
        ] =
            bit;


        modules[
            i%3 +
            size -
            8 -
            3
        ][
            Math.floor(i/3)
        ] =
            bit;

    }


    /*
       Formato:
       L + máscara 0.

       L = 01
       01 << 3 = 8
    */

    const formatBits =
        qrBchTypeInfo(8);


    for(
        let i=0;
        i<15;
        i++
    ){

        const bit =
            (
                (
                    formatBits >>>
                    i
                )
                &
                1
            )
            === 1;


        if(i < 6){

            modules[i][8] =
                bit;

        }
        else if(i < 8){

            modules[i+1][8] =
                bit;

        }
        else{

            modules[
                size-15+i
            ][8] =
                bit;

        }


        if(i < 8){

            modules[8][
                size-i-1
            ] =
                bit;

        }
        else if(i < 9){

            modules[8][
                15-i-1+1
            ] =
                bit;

        }
        else{

            modules[8][
                15-i-1
            ] =
                bit;

        }

    }


    /*
       Módulo fijo.
    */

    modules[
        size-8
    ][8] = true;


    /*
       Colocación de datos.
       Máscara 0:
       (row + col) % 2 === 0
    */

    let row =
        size-1;

    let inc =
        -1;

    let bitIndex = 7;

    let byteIndex = 0;


    for(
        let col=size-1;
        col>0;
        col-=2
    ){

        if(
            col===6
        ){

            col--;

        }


        while(true){

            for(
                let c=0;
                c<2;
                c++
            ){

                const currentCol =
                    col-c;


                if(
                    modules[row][currentCol]
                    !== null
                ){

                    continue;

                }


                let dark = false;


                if(
                    byteIndex <
                    finalBytes.length
                ){

                    dark =
                        (
                            (
                                finalBytes[
                                    byteIndex
                                ] >>>
                                bitIndex
                            )
                            &
                            1
                        )
                        === 1;

                }


                /*
                   Máscara 0.
                */

                if(
                    (
                        row +
                        currentCol
                    ) % 2 === 0
                ){

                    dark =
                        !dark;

                }


                modules[row][currentCol] =
                    dark;


                bitIndex--;


                if(
                    bitIndex === -1
                ){

                    byteIndex++;

                    bitIndex=7;

                }

            }


            row += inc;


            if(
                row < 0 ||
                row >= size
            ){

                row -= inc;

                inc =
                    -inc;

                break;

            }

        }

    }


    /*
       Seguridad: ninguna celda queda null.
    */

    for(
        let r=0;
        r<size;
        r++
    ){

        for(
            let c=0;
            c<size;
            c++
        ){

            if(
                modules[r][c] === null
            ){

                modules[r][c] =
                    false;

            }

        }

    }


    return modules;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   QR → SVG
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function qrMatrixToSVG(
    matrix
){

    const size =
        matrix.length;


    const quiet =
        4;


    const total =
        size +
        quiet*2;


    let svg =

        `<svg
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            viewBox="0 0 ${total} ${total}"
            shape-rendering="crispEdges"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Código QR del diagnóstico">`;


    svg +=

        `<rect
            width="${total}"
            height="${total}"
            fill="white"/>`;


    for(
        let row=0;
        row<size;
        row++
    ){

        for(
            let col=0;
            col<size;
            col++
        ){

            if(
                matrix[row][col]
            ){

                svg +=

                    `<rect
                        x="${col+quiet}"
                        y="${row+quiet}"
                        width="1"
                        height="1"
                        fill="black"/>`;

            }

        }

    }


    svg +=
        "</svg>";


    return svg;

}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   GENERAR QR
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function generateQR(
    text
){

    const container =
        document.getElementById(
            "qrcode"
        );


    if(!container){
        return;
    }


    try{

        const matrix =
            createQRMatrix(
                text
            );


        container.innerHTML =
            qrMatrixToSVG(
                matrix
            );


    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "Error QR:",
            error
        );


        /*
           Segundo intento: reutiliza exactamente el mismo
           contenido del QR. Nunca se genera un resumen distinto
           al informe que corresponde a este diagnóstico.
        */

        try{

            const fallback = text;


            const matrix =
                createQRMatrix(
                    fallback
                );


            container.innerHTML =
                qrMatrixToSVG(
                    matrix
                );


        }catch(secondError){

            container.innerHTML = `

                <div class="notice danger">

                    No fue posible generar el código QR.

                </div>

            `;

        }

    }

}


/* =========================================================
   LOCAL STORAGE
========================================================= */

const STORAGE_KEY =
    "diagnostico_ft_9_resultados";


function createId(){

    if(
        window.crypto &&
        typeof window.crypto.randomUUID ===
        "function"
    ){

        return window.crypto.randomUUID();

    }


    return (

        Date.now().toString(36)

        +

        Math.random()
            .toString(36)
            .substring(2)

    );

}


function saveDiagnostic(
    data
){

    let records = [];


    try{

        const existing =
            localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEY
            );


        if(existing){

            records =
                JSON.parse(
                    existing
                );

        }


        if(
            !Array.isArray(records)
        ){

            records = [];

        }

    }catch(error){

        records = [];

    }


    const record = {

        id:
            createId(),

        timestamp:
            new Date().toISOString(),


        student:{

            name:
                data.student,

            section:
                data.section,

            institution:
                data.institution,

            date:
                data.date

        },


        cognitive:{

            score:
                data.score,

            level:
                data.level,

            results:
                data.cognitiveResults

        },


        psychomotor:{

            cards:
                getCardArrangement(),

            cardsPlaced:
                getCardsPlaced(),

            requiredPortsConnected:
                connectedRequiredPorts(),

            requiredPortsTotal:
                requiredPorts.length,


            /*
               INFORMACIÓN INTERNA COMPLETA.
            */

            connections:
                connections.map(
                    connection => ({

                        from:
                            connection.from,

                        to:
                            connection.to,

                        fromDevice:
                            connection.fromDevice,

                        fromPort:
                            connection.fromPort,

                        toDevice:
                            connection.toDevice,

                        toPort:
                            connection.toPort,

                        technicallyCorrect:
                            connection.technicallyCorrect,

                        timestamp:
                            connection.timestamp

                    })
                )

        },


        procedural:
            data.procedural,


        socioaffective:
            data.socio,


        strengths:
            data.strengths,


        support:
            data.support,


        report:
            data.report,


        qr:
            buildQRData(data)

    };


    records.push(record);


    try{

        localStorage.setItem(
            STORAGE_KEY,
            JSON.stringify(
                records
            )
        );

    }catch(error){

        console.error(
            "No se pudo guardar el diagnóstico:",
            error
        );

    }

}


/* =========================================================
   FINALIZAR
========================================================= */

function finishDiagnostic(){

    const message =
        document.getElementById(
            "stage3Message"
        );


    if(
        !socioComplete()
    ){

        message.textContent =
            "Responda los seis indicadores antes de finalizar.";

        return;

    }


    const data =
        buildReport();


    const qrData =
        buildQRData(
            data
        );


    document.getElementById(
        "summary"
    ).innerHTML =
        renderStudentReport(
            data,
            qrData
        );


    /*
       AQUÍ SE GENERA EL QR
       DESDE EL PROPIO HTML.
    */

    generateQR(
        qrData
    );


    /*
       Guardar resultados,
       incluyendo las conexiones técnicas.
    */

    saveDiagnostic(
        data
    );


    if(
        timerInterval
    ){

        clearInterval(
            timerInterval
        );

    }


    goToStage(4);

}

            field.addEventListener(

                updateStage1Button
            );

        }

    }
);
